glosses: A native or inhabitant of the region of Brittany, France.
The Celtic language of Brittany.
A village in Alberta, Canada.
Of, from or relating to the region of Brittany, France.

A musical wind instrument possessing a flexible bag inflated by bellows, a double-reed melody pipe and up to four drone pipes; any aerophone that produces sound using air from a reservoir to vibrate enclosed reeds.

examples.text: Bagpipes are traditionally played in most Celtic regions and many former parts of the British Empire.
